units.title: An explicit separation ratio has an exponential floor
units.reader_note: Scalar ingredient for Proposition B.7; the actual TV-to-ratio bound remains open.
units.statement: The explicit single-block ratio is at least the exponential scale used in the lower-bound argument.
assumptions: All square roots, exponentials, powers and divisions are literal real operations. Positivity is proved internally.

notation.text: Short notation for the square root and spectral ratio.

steps.title: Check the logarithm domains
steps.text: Write s for the square root of the condition number. The source assumption makes every denominator and logarithm argument positive.
steps.lean: hs, hs0, hm, hp, ha, hb and hr establish all domains internally via Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le and positivity.

steps.title: Bound the reciprocal log ratio
steps.text: The source obtains this final bound through an integral and the sharper intermediate constant 8/3. The Lean route instead splits the ratio and applies the same canonical log(x) ≤ x−1 theorem twice. It proves the displayed constant 3 without claiming the source integral identity.
steps.lean: hla and hlb call Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos; hprod, hfra and hlog combine them. The original integral route and this sufficient alternative remain distinct.

steps.title: Keep the numerator from decaying too quickly
steps.text: Negate the reciprocal logarithm estimate, exponentiate and take the natural power n.
steps.lean: hlower and hexp use Real.log_div and Real.le_log_iff_exp_le; hpower uses Real.exp_nat_mul and pow_le_pow_left₀.

steps.title: Control the denominator
steps.text: Use the elementary rational comparison, then the canonical exponential tangent bound.
steps.lean: hkernel clears positive denominators; hden uses Real.add_one_le_exp with 2n/s. hdenpos proves that division preserves the comparison.

steps.title: Divide and combine the exponents
steps.text: The positive numerator and denominator bounds give the scalar floor. Its use with the actual TV ratio bound is the next separate assembly.
steps.lean: hquot calls div_le_div₀, and heq uses Real.exp_sub. No TV or Gaussian law is a premise of this scalar theorem.

units.lean_statement: Exactly the two source numerical assumptions; no estimate is supplied as a hypothesis.
units.lean_proof: Two shared logarithm tangent bounds, monotonicity, the exponential tangent bound, then positive division.
units.boundary: Exact scalar second comparison of B.7 Eq19 at natural n>=3 and real kappa>=4, including kappa4. Only literal sqrt/exp/Nat power/real division; positivity and logarithm domains derived internally. Actual single-block TV first ratio bound, selected tilt, sphere/Poisson Eq24, product amplification, exact-oracle transcript/query reductions, fixed-spectrum hidden-eigenbasis, both main theorems and purification remain separate and open.
